g.text: where the money goes, on today's figures:
Treasury yields of 6 Nov 2026; shares 7.5% a year
(four iBonds funds, then five Treasury bonds)
Extra Treasuries fill any gap in the ten if
cash waiting earns nothing. If rates hold
they are never needed, and all of it is hers
the bottom, $95,000: held in Treasuries since 2028
the rest, $20,000: from the shares moved in 2031
Each end is counted below the expected payout
paid above the top: $28,682 in 2033, promised to
no one, for building costs that overrun, a stronger
Taiwan dollar or a co-sponsor falling short
Treasuries: held to the end, they pay out on set dates
